label: v253
changes: People now opens with the family profiles first, while missing records and readiness checks live in their own To-do & readiness tab.
Family tree is now a real, interactive generation map with parent, child, partner, step, foster, adoptive and separated relationships, plus GEDCOM import and export.
Travel document watch now recommends when to start renewing: nine months before passport expiry and six months before visa or residence-permit expiry.
Family Hub and Business Hub are clearly labelled beside every space name, so a custom logo or title never hides which kind of space is open.
Business spaces now use team, work, operations and business language throughout Pulse, People, Capture, Calendar, credentials, insurance, chat and settings.
Business calendars exclude family-only occasions while keeping plans, team birthdays, work travel documents, medical checks and time away.
System, Light and Dark appearance controls remain available at the bottom of the main navigation, and classic Teluva remains available as a full rollback option.
